statement: The v7.3 f_uac1 configfs function provides playback/capture channel masks, lists of sample rates, sample sizes, and optional mute/volume feature units. Descriptor channel count is derived from enabled mask bits. Unlike f_uac2, the pinned UAC1 configfs ABI lists no terminal-type overrides. Its streaming endpoints are isochronous; the options do not guarantee a controller-exact UAC1 descriptor graph.

applicability.revision: Linux mainline v6.11, v6.12 or v7.3 as pinned; family revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: Linux UAC1 gadget-function options and descriptor construction, not a reference DualSense device measurement.
